cards.title: THE CURB HAS QUESTIONS.
cards.message: Mostly about the distance. It thought you two were closer.

cards.title: PARKED WITH CONFIDENCE.
cards.message: Accuracy has declined to comment.

cards.title: A STRONG OPENING ATTEMPT.
cards.message: We were surprised to learn it was also the final attempt.

cards.title: THE PARKING IS ABSTRACT.
cards.message: We understand the concept. We're still working on the execution.

cards.title: THIS PARKING JOB HAS RANGE.
cards.message: Specifically, the range between your tires and the curb.

cards.title: THE VEHICLE HAS LANDED.
cards.message: Whether it has parked remains an editorial question.

cards.title: A BOLD INTERPRETATION OF PARALLEL.
cards.message: PNN respects your commitment to exploring other angles.

cards.title: YOUR CAR HAS REQUESTED A SECOND TAKE.
cards.message: It believes it can do better with different direction.

cards.title: ANNOYINGLY WELL PARKED.
cards.message: We brought an entire stack of sarcastic cards. Now look what you've done.

cards.title: NOTHING TO REPORT.
cards.message: Straight. Tidy. Considerate. An absolute disaster for the newsroom.

cards.title: THE CURB FEELS SEEN.
cards.message: Close enough to be friendly. Far enough to maintain boundaries.

cards.title: YOU LEFT ROOM FOR OTHER PEOPLE.
cards.message: An unexpected development. PNN is preparing a special report.

cards.title: COMPLIMENT ENCLOSED.
cards.message: Your parking is excellent. We're as uncomfortable with this as you are.

cards.title: PNN HAS FOUND YOUR FLAW.
cards.message: You've left us nothing to make fun of. Deeply inconsiderate.

cards.title: SUSPICIOUSLY COMPETENT.
cards.message: Inspector Clueso would like to know how long you have been practicing.

cards.title: YOUR CAR UNDERSTOOD THE ASSIGNMENT.
cards.message: Please ask it to stop making the other cars look bad.

cards.title: YOUR WINDSHIELD HAS BEEN PROMOTED.
cards.message: It is now a community bulletin board. This appointment expires when you remove the card.

cards.title: UNSOLICITED LOCAL JOURNALISM.
cards.message: You parked. We published. Neither of us expected much from this encounter.

cards.title: YOUR WIPER HAS ACCEPTED A DELIVERY.
cards.message: We apologize for conducting newsroom business through your car's eyebrows.

cards.title: THE CAR DECLINED AN INTERVIEW.
cards.message: It offered no comment, which we found unusually professional.

cards.title: LOCAL CAR CAUGHT DOING NOTHING WRONG.
cards.message: Editors are struggling to find an angle. Your cooperation is not helping.

cards.title: THIS CARD IS THE WHOLE INCIDENT.
cards.message: Please do not give our newsroom credit for a more sophisticated operation.

cards.title: PLEASE REMAIN ENTIRELY UNIMPRESSED.
cards.message: PNN has left a card on your car and is behaving as though this constitutes a media campaign.

cards.title: THIS WAS SUPPOSED TO BE MORE IMPRESSIVE.
cards.message: Please imagine a dramatic reveal. The printing department has done its best.

cards.title: YOUR CAR ALMOST GOT PRANKED.
cards.message: Then someone said, "We should probably have a plan." Momentum was lost.

cards.title: PRANK CANCELLED: EXCESSIVE MEETING.
cards.message: Three ideas. Four opinions. No decision. Please enjoy this administrative outcome.

cards.title: WE HAD SOMETHING ELABORATE PLANNED.
cards.message: This card represents a substantial reduction in scope.

cards.title: THE PRANK BUDGET WAS ONE CARD.
cards.message: You are currently holding the entire operation.

cards.title: THEORETICALLY PRANKED.
cards.message: In the planning meeting, it was spectacular. This is the version that made it out of the meeting.

cards.title: SPARED BY A TECHNICALITY.
cards.message: The technicality was that we couldn't think of anything funnier than this card.
